question: Who was appointed as the new Chief Justice of the Madras High Court in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Munishwar Nath Bhandari.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Munishwar Nath Bhandari (As of Feb 2022) has been appointed Chief Justice of the Madras High Court, the Law Ministry said on Thursday.**
 
• **Justice Bhandari:**
 
 
• (As of Feb 2022) had taken over as the Acting Chief Justice of the Madras High Court after the transfer of **Justice Sanjib Banerjee to Meghalaya.**
 
• Justice M N Bhandari was transferred to the **Madras High Court in November 2021.**
 
• The Centre has notified the appointment of **Justice Munishwar Nath Bhandari as the Acting Chief Justice of the Allahabad High Court.**
 
• Justice Bhandari, the senior-most Judge of the Allahabad High Court, will be performing the duties of the office of the Chief Justice of the High Court.
 
• Justice Bhandari was appointed as Judge of the High Court of Rajasthan **High Court on July 5, 2007.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Satish Chandra Sharma:**

 
 
• On **28 June 2022 took oath as the Chief Justice of the Delhi High Court.**
 
• He was sworn in by Delhi's Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena at a ceremony in the Raj Niwas.
 
• Justice Sharma had earlier served as the Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court.
 
 
 
• **Justice Prashant Kumar Mishra:**
 
 
• He is the senior-most judge of the Chhattisgarh High Court and has been appointed as its acting Chief Justice (CJ).
 
• He will assume charge from June 1, 2021, following the retirement of Justice Parappillil Ramakrishnan Nair Ramachandra Menon, Chief Justice,** Chhattisgarh High Court, on 31 May'21.**
 
• The high courts of Allahabad and Calcutta are also being run by acting CJs.
 
 
 
• **Sanjay Kumar Mishra:**
 
 
• **​Enforcement Directorate (ED) Chief Sanjay Kumar Mishra has got a one-year extension till 18 November 2022.**
 
• Mishra is a **1984-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer of the Income Tax Department cadre.**
 
• **He was first appointed as the ED director for a period of two years by an order of November 19, 2018, and later his term of two years was replaced by three years in 2020.**
